Connect Displai to your Enterprise
Canva account

Connect

1 Click Connect Canva.
2 Click Continue another way.
3 Click Continue with Microsoft.
4 Click Use another account.
5 Log in using the store_account.
6 Click Continue.
7 Select the store_account.
8 Click Allow.

Disconnect

1 Click your name in the bottom left corner, then click Account Administration.
2 Click Disconnect.
3 Click Disconnect to confirm.

Click Help in the left sidebar for additional support.
